executive.verdict: The current Offisos web application is NOT a practical replacement for common AutoCAD workflows. Geometry primitives (LINE/RECTANGLE/CIRCLE/POLYLINE with absolute, relative and polar coordinate entry), annotation creation (TEXT/MTEXT/DIMLINEAR), BIM story/wall creation, layout/title-block creation, and one zoom command (ZOOMEXTENTS) respond correctly at the command line. However every professional-critical subsystem fails: layers are unusable (all geometry lands on layer '0' through every command path), object picking is non-functional, navigation is a single fit-view command, arrays create invisible results, blocks are unreachable, hatches do not exist, BIM openings are unreachable, viewports fail engine-side, nothing persists across reload, SAVE exports a stale disconnected snapshot, DXF export rejects the app's own line/circle geometry, and DXF import hangs and destroys the workspace viewport. A competent AutoCAD user could not complete any of the 25 benchmark projects to a usable professional result.
executive.score_rationale: +geometry primitives and coordinate entry (exact echoes, relative/polar verified to 6 decimal places); +DIMLINEAR/TEXT/MTEXT creation and rendering; +STORY/WALL creation and rendering; +LAYOUTNEW/TITLEBLOCK; +ROTATE/TRIM/ARRAY select-by-P flow; +zero browser console/page errors (silent-failure design). -layers (0 working activation path in practice), -selection (two desynced selection paths, dead picking), -views (no zoom/pan), -rendering (all-or-nothing entity clipping), -persistence (total loss, stale save, no open), -interop (DXF export/import both broken; import destructive), -blocks/hatch/attributes absent or unreachable, -layout viewports engine-side failure, -state machine instability over long sessions, -command keyword inconsistency, -dead application menubar, -no command discovery (no autocomplete, F1 hint false).

TEXT and MTEXT creation flows complete with correct echoes
STORY ('Ground Floor' level 0 height 3000) and WALL ((0,0)->(5000,0) width 240 height 3000) BIM creation works and renders as a closed plan
LAYOUTNEW (A3 landscape, 10mm margins, fit) and TITLEBLOCK (5 rows, 180x60mm) work
ARRAY command flow with proper keyword prompts (Rectangular/Polar, 'Path is unsupported' honestly disclosed) and 'one atomic revision' semantics
ROTATE completes ('1 object(s) 90 degrees about (0,0)') via previous-selection
Command error messages for bad coordinates are helpful and non-destructive
Zero browser console messages and zero page errors across the entire ~70-minute session — all failures surface as command-line echoes (no hydration crashes, no JS exceptions)
